ABOUT US

About PanPan Marine

Equipment selection, quotation and manufacturer coordination for underwater inspection and maintenance robots used on water infrastructure.

PanPan Marine, a PanPanTech brand.

Operated by Guangzhou PanPanTech Co., Ltd. in Guangzhou, China, PanPan Marine helps international infrastructure owners and contractors select, configure and buy underwater robots from the manufacturer Boya Gongdao (ROBOOCEAN).

Discuss your application with us at panda@panpantechnology.com.

What we do

  • Match the task and site conditions to a suitable platform
  • Coordinate configuration and technical questions with the manufacturer
  • Prepare itemised quotations with clear scope and responsibilities
  • Arrange documentation, training and support contacts before delivery

PanPan Marine

Start with the operating conditions.

Inspection, tunnel access, contact cleaning and sediment removal are distinct applications. Each deserves a task-specific assessment, and every quotation should make clear who is responsible for what.

Three roles in every order

Manufacturer: the producer of the equipment and source of product information.

Seller: the legal entity named in the quotation and purchase agreement.

Support provider: the party responsible for each agreed technical and warranty obligation.
